sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Nasciens was an Arthurian hero. He once ruled as a pagan king under the name Seraphe. The new name Nasciens means one who knows nothing. His bold effort to gaze on the Grail struck him blind. He then turned hermit monk and guided the men riding out on the Grail quest.

okr.objective: Nasciens is an Arthurian hero who turned to the Grail quest.
